versions.changelog:
aim-blog-write v1.0.0

- New skill for generating SEO-optimized blogs via an external agent (seo_agent).
- Enforces secret key setup before any content generation (guided user flow for first-time use).
- Requires users to provide theme, industry, and language for each blog request—no defaults assumed.
- Automates end-to-end flow: calls AEP seo_agent, parses JSON, downloads images, and outputs a Word document with embedded images and metadata.
- All configuration strictly via the local .env file; user edits handled through the agent, not manually.
- Includes robust error handling for missing fields, image download issues, and credential validation.
